items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I couldn’t go out with Shep Fields... he threatened to take me to the union. We all belonged to the union by the time we were 16.

ctx.x: And he says, “Sonny, don’t come to me for lessons if you quit school.” Because he was a firm believer in getting your papers. And of course we knew that that was a joke but, it meant my having to stay in school and I couldn’t go out with Shep Fields, and he threatened to take me to the union. We all belonged to the union by the time we were 16. So my mother got on the phone and she said, “Mr. Fields, do you realize that my son is a minor?” And that was the end of it.
Oh. So you hadn’t even told him how old you were?
